name: Keqiwear Germany KW61 Max Smart Watch
description:
KEQIWEAR Germany KW61 Max Smart Watch – Multifunctional, Stylish, and Convenient

Stay connected, track your health, and elevate your style with the KEQIWEAR KW61 Max Smart Watch, designed for modern lifestyles.

Key Features:

Multifunctional Smartwatch: Monitor heart rate, track sleep, measure steps, and access multiple fitness modes for a healthier lifestyle.

Two Straps Included: Customize your look with two interchangeable straps for every occasion.

Wireless Charging: Convenient and fast charging without the hassle of cables.

Long Battery Backup: Enjoy up to 7–10 days of usage on a full charge.

Fast Charging Time: Fully charges in approximately 1.5–2 hours, keeping you ready quickly.

Smart Notifications: Receive calls, messages, and app alerts directly on your wrist.

Sleek Design: Modern and stylish design suitable for both casual and formal wear.

Box Contents:

1x KEQIWEAR KW61 Max Smart Watch

2x Interchangeable Straps

1x Wireless Charging Cable

1x User Manual
